rules: Curated category batches only; never indiscriminately mirror an entire site.
Public CC0 assets may be staged automatically with source URL, license, hash and file metadata.
Authentication-required sources are explicit lanes and are never bypassed.
Animated production characters must be FBX before READY_FOR_IMPORT.
Production textures must be PNG/TGA and channel-packed where appropriate before READY_FOR_IMPORT.
STAGED is not IMPORTED, INTEGRATED or ACCEPTED.
Provider access terms are separate from asset licenses: a CC0 asset library may still prohibit automated or bulk downloading.
Never automate a provider merely because its assets are free or CC0; automation requires a documented public API/direct-download pattern or explicit provider-compatible access.

selection_policy.objective: Maximize production usefulness per GB/hour while preserving provenance and avoiding chaotic stock duplication.
anti_chaos_rules: Do not download the same category blindly from every provider; keep the best-fit 1-3 candidates per warehouse slot before bulk duplication.
Prefer Tier A sources for automatic intake because licenses/formats are clearer.
Hero characters and signature locations require realism/identity-fit; stylized CC0 packs are background or pipeline stock unless upgraded.
Use 2K default material intake for the target laptop; preserve higher source resolutions only when justified for hero surfaces.
Audio/music candidates must be categorized by bed/spot/stinger/foley/voice/score before READY_FOR_IMPORT.
Every staged file must retain provider, source page, license class, size, hash, intended slot and state.
